infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MavApp uses your location to send your truck position to MAVTRACK while tracking is active.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MavApp uses background location so MAVTRACK can continue receiving your truck position when the screen is locked or another app is open.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow MavApp to use your location while tracking is active.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow MavApp to use your location in the background so MAVTRACK can continue receiving truck GPS.
